newsitem.title: FRANCE: Airbus has no comment on EU Boeing decision report.
newsitem.headline: Airbus has no comment on EU Boeing decision report.

text.p: European planemaking consortium Airbus Industrie said it had no comment on a report that European Union antitrust experts recommended on Wednesday banning the merger between Boeing Co and McDonnell Douglas Corp .
"We have said everything we have to say on the subject," a spokesman told Reuters. "This is an issue between Boeing and the Commission and it is not for us to comment any further," he said.
A meeting of antitrust experts from the 15 EU states recommended unanimously on Wednesday banning the $14 billion merger between Boeing and McDonnell, an industry source said.

The source was reading from the official opinion agreed by the experts. The European Commission is widely expected to follow the advice at its regular meeting next week after Boeing did not change its merger agreement and offer the commission a plan it found acceptable.
"The advisory committee again unanimously supported the Commission view that the remedies offered were unsufficient," the source told Reuters, speaking on the condition of anonymity.
A majority in the committee was of the opinion that Boeing's proposals to avoid that defence contracts money 'spill-over' to commercial aviation programmes "showed progress", the source said.
